Services

Engineering that covers the whole path from idea to operations.

Pick one service or combine several. Either way, a single delivery lead keeps scope, quality and budget in one place.

What we offer

Six services, shaped around how products really grow.

Product engineering

Custom web platforms and back-office systems built around your workflow instead of a generic template.

  • Discovery and clickable prototypes
  • Typed front ends and documented APIs
  • Automated tests on every merge

Dedicated squads

A stable, cross-functional team that works inside your roadmap, rituals and tooling as an extension of your staff.

  • Lead engineer plus 3 to 8 specialists
  • Ramp-up inside two weeks
  • Monthly scaling up or down

Telecom & messaging

Carrier-facing systems where throughput, delivery receipts and billing accuracy matter more than visual polish.

  • SMPP, HTTP and SIP integrations
  • OTP and A2P routing with failover
  • Rating, reconciliation and CDR tooling

Mobile apps

Native and cross-platform apps that stay fast on mid-range phones and patchy connections.

  • Kotlin, Swift or React Native
  • Offline-first data sync
  • Store release and crash monitoring

Cloud, DevOps & security

Infrastructure you can rebuild from code, deployments you can roll back in minutes, and access you can audit.

  • Migration and landing-zone setup
  • CI/CD, observability and on-call
  • Hardening reviews and cost reports

AI & automation

Practical machine learning and language-model features that remove repetitive work, with humans kept in the loop.

  • Document and ticket triage
  • Retrieval over your own knowledge base
  • Evaluation sets before anything ships
Our solutions

Two platforms we bring to every engagement.

Both are proven building blocks that we tailor to your traffic, rules and integrations rather than rebuild from scratch.

Telecom platform

Synthiq Relay

A messaging core that accepts traffic from your apps and routes it across several carriers by cost, quality and country rules. If one route degrades, Relay shifts traffic automatically and keeps the receipts consistent.

  • Least-cost and quality-based routing
  • Real-time delivery dashboards
  • Per-client rating and invoicing exports
Operations AI

Synthiq Pilot

An assistant for support and operations teams. Pilot reads alerts, tickets and runbooks, drafts the next action and waits for a person to approve it, so routine work moves faster without losing control.

  • Connectors for common ticketing and chat tools
  • Approval step on every action
  • Full audit log of prompts and outcomes
Engagement models

Choose the contract that fits the uncertainty.

Dedicated team

Best when the roadmap is long and priorities shift. You get a steady team at a fixed monthly rate and direct say over the backlog.

Fixed price

Best when scope is clear and stable. We agree on deliverables, milestones and price up front, and we carry the delivery risk.

Time & material

Best for discovery, audits or evolving products. You pay for hours used, tracked weekly against an agreed budget ceiling.

Next step

Bring us the problem, not a finished spec.

A 30-minute call is usually enough to map the risks, the first milestone and the team you would need.
